logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of ruthenium complexes was measured using the shake-flask method and ICP-MS analysis. An equal volume of H2O was added to 2 mL of stock solution of ruthenium complexes in octanol, followed by 24 h incubations at 37 °C in shaking mode. After 24 h, the mixture was centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 10 min to isolate the water and octanol phases. Subsequently, 100 µL aliquots from each phase were digested in HNO3 (400 µL) and diluted to a final volume of 10 mL. The ruthenium content in each layer  was obtained by referencing the standard curve. Po/w is the ratio of organic phase concentration (Co) to aqueous phase concentration (Cw)
